description: Add comprehensive unit tests for the new OCR integration and scanner enhancements. Tests cover the scan_ocr_service, updated ScanPage entity, ScannerController state transitions for text detection, and searchable PDF generation logic.
steps: 1. Create frontend/test/scanner/scan_page_test.dart with tests for the updated ScanPage entity: verify extractedText field, ocrProcessing flag, copyWith behavior for new fields.

2. Create frontend/test/scanner/scanner_controller_test.dart with tests for: goToTextDetection() stage transition, setPageOcrText() storing text per page, text detection flow state management (from reviewing -> textDetection and back).

3. Create frontend/test/scanner/scan_ocr_service_test.dart with a test that verifies the service interface (since ML Kit is not available in test, test the logic around temp file creation and cleanup, and mock the OCR call).
acceptance_criteria: scan_page_test.dart has tests for new fields (extractedText, ocrProcessing) in copyWith
scanner_controller_test.dart tests the new stage transitions and OCR state methods
All test files follow the existing test patterns in frontend/test/scanner/
Tests are structured with proper group/test blocks and meaningful assertions
verification: Read all new test files to confirm correct Dart/flutter_test syntax
Verify tests import the correct source files
Verify test assertions are meaningful and would catch regressions
